boundary_and_wings.choice: log H0 and log U may both be chosen asymptotic to (log B)^(1/4), below the candidate j=1 bulk log exponent 1/3.
boundary_and_wings.minimal_scale_harmonic: At k=1, (H_l(rs)-1)/G(rs)^j = H_l(rs)G(rs)^(-j)-G(rs)^(-j), again a difference of multiplicative channels.
boundary_and_wings.minimal_scale_zero: At k=1 (OE h=1, EE h=2), (G(rs)-1)/G(rs)^j = G(rs)^(1-j)-G(rs)^(-j), a difference of two multiplicative 2-variable channels.
boundary_and_wings.small_coordinate_majorant_fixed_channel: For the zero j=1 channel, the full local coefficient is bounded by the pure scale coefficient a(h); sum_{h<=Y}a(h)<<Y. Therefore min(r,s)<U contributes O(B log U). All fixed j>=1 zero/harmonic channels are pointwise dominated by this majorant.
boundary_and_wings.small_height_majorant: Every normalized shell gap has absolute value <=1, so h<=H0 contributes O(B log H0). With log H0=(log B)^(1/4), this is O(B(log B)^(1/4)).

exact_globalization.factorization: D_{j,l}(s_h,s_r,s_s)=A_{j,l}(s_h) B_{j,l}(s_r) B_{j,l}(s_s) C_{j,l}(s_h,s_r,s_s), up to the finite 2-adic parity factor.
exact_globalization.inert_prime_correction: At q=3 mod 4, the h-factor is 1 and the r-s coprime correction is exactly 1-x*y.
exact_globalization.split_prime_full_local: D_q(z,x,y)=1 + pure h + pure r + pure s + h-r + h-s terms; r-s simultaneous support is forbidden by gcd(r,s)=1.
exact_globalization.statement: The growing-base uniformity issue is removed by treating h,r,s as simultaneous multiplicative variables instead of applying Selberg-Delange to h with rs frozen.
exact_globalization.weighted_l1: For every fixed delta>0, sum |c(a,b,c)|/(abc)^(1/2+delta)<infinity. Locally C_q-1 starts with at least two positive coordinate exponents, hence ||C_q-1||_delta=O_delta(q^(-1-2delta)).

nonzero_harmonic.base: B_{j,l}(s)=zeta(s)^beta1 L(s,chi4)^gamma1 L(s,xi_{8l})^(3^-j) E_{b,j,l}(s), beta1=(1+3^-j)/2, gamma1=(3^-j-1)/2

pure_one_variable_factors.residual_euler_products: All E-factors have local quotient 1+O(q^(-2 sigma)) after matching the displayed first-prime coefficients.

selberg_delange_consequences.harmonic_base: sum_{n<=X} b_{j,l}(n)=c X(log X)^(beta1-1) plus finite-order remainder
selberg_delange_consequences.harmonic_scale: For fixed j,l>=1, the Selberg-Delange z=0 expansion has 1/Gamma(-m)=0 at every finite term, hence sum_{n<=X} a_{j,l}(n)=O_A(X(log(2X))^-A) for every fixed A, at the stated Hecke zero-free external-theorem level.
selberg_delange_consequences.zero_base: sum_{n<=X} b_{j,0}(n)=c X(log X)^(beta0-1) plus arbitrary finite-order log expansion
selberg_delange_consequences.zero_scale: sum_{n<=X} a_{j,0}(n)=c X(log X)^(3^-j-1) plus arbitrary finite-order log expansion

uniform_rectangle_lemma.form: After convolving the global weighted-l1 correction, fixed-channel boxes H x R x S have the product of the three one-variable Selberg-Delange mains plus an error bounded by log^C times H^(3/4+eps)RS + HR^(3/4+eps)S + HRS^(3/4+eps), together with the three one-variable SD remainders. The implicit constant is fixed for j,l,eps and does not depend on a frozen base rs.
uniform_rectangle_lemma.reason: Split correction coefficients at sqrt(H),sqrt(R),sqrt(S); the global weighted-l1 norm gives exactly the Stage12-N1-3a 3/4+eps tail argument in three variables.
